compliance.source: SparkFun Pro Micro (DEV-12640) 16MHz/5V graphical datasheet ProMicro16MHzv2.pdf and SparkFun Pro Micro v13a Eagle design files (SparkFun_Pro_Micro_v13a.zip, .sch): ATmega32U4 with USB, a regulator, a 16 MHz crystal and LEDs – no transmitter; read 2026-10-31

hints: VCC 5 V at 500 mA (graphical datasheet): everything the keyboard half feeds from VCC – LEDs, OLED, the other half through the TRRS jack – passes the module's 500 mA PTC from USB
ATmega32U4: at most 40 mA per pin, 200 mA through VCC and GND; each port group's IOH and IOL sums at most 100 mA (datasheet 29.1, table 29-1 notes 3 and 4)
sources: SparkFun Pro Micro (DEV-12640) 16MHz/5V graphical datasheet ProMicro16MHzv2.pdf, https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/f/d/8/0/d/ProMicro16MHzv2.pdf (linked from https://www.sparkfun.com/pro-micro-5v-16mhz.html), read 2026-10-31: pinout TXO PD3, RXI PD2, 2 PD1 SDA, 3 PD0 SCL, 4 PD4, 5 PC6, 6 PD7, 7 PE6, 8 PB4, 9 PB5, 10 PB6, 16 PB2 MOSI, 14 PB3 MISO, 15 PB1 SCK, A0–A3 PF7–PF4, RAW, GND, RST, VCC; power: RAW 6–16 V, VCC 5 V at 500 mA, absolute maximum VCC 6 V, maximum current for the chip 200 mA, per pin 40 mA (20 mA recommended); the jumper 'Connects VCC to USB (bypasses regulator)'

SparkFun Pro Micro v13a Eagle design files (SparkFun_Pro_Micro_v13a.zip, .sch), https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/a/2/1/f/2/SparkFun_Pro_Micro_v13a.zip, read 2026-10-31 as XML: USB VBUS → F1 (PTC SMD 500mA) → SJ1 ('Closed for 5V Board') → VCC; F1 → D2 (diode) → RAW → U2 MIC5219 → VCC; R2 10 kΩ RESET to VCC; LED1 (red) with R11 1 kΩ on VCC; RX/TX LEDs with 330 Ω; C10 1 µF and C13 10 µF on VCC, C19 10 µF on RAW; Y1 16 MHz with 22 pF; R5/R7 22 Ω in D+/D−

SparkFun 'Pro Micro & Fio V3 Hookup Guide', section Hardware Overview, Power Pins, https://learn.sparkfun.com/tutorials/pro-micro--fio-v3-hookup-guide/all, read 2026-10-31: RAW about 4.8 V from USB, up to 12 V applied; VCC 5 V on the 5V/16MHz version, usable as an output to supply other devices; RST pulled high by 10 kΩ, active low

Microchip (Atmel) ATmega16U4/32U4 datasheet Atmel-7766J-USB-ATmega16U4/32U4-Datasheet_04/2016, https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/Atmel-7766-8-bit-AVR-ATmega16U4-32U4_Datasheet.pdf, read 2026-10-31: features – 2.7–5.5 V, 16 MHz at 4.5 V, −40 … +85 °C (vdd_op_min_v and VCC's v_op_min_v 4.5: the board runs at 16 MHz); 29.1 – pins −0.5 V … VCC + 0.5 V (v_max_v 5.5 at VCC 5 V), 6.0 V maximum operating voltage, 40 mA per I/O pin, 200 mA through VCC and GND pins; table 29-1 – VIL ≤ 0.2 VCC − 0.1 V, VIH ≥ 0.2 VCC + 0.9 V (vil_v 0.85 and vih_v 1.95: their values at 4.75 and 5.25 V, the stricter ends of the USB range), VOH ≥ 4.2 V at −10 mA and VOL ≤ 0.7 V at 10 mA (VCC 5 V), RPU 20–50 kΩ, ICC 27 mA max active at 16 MHz and 5 V; tables 10-3, 10-6, 10-8, 10-11, 10-13 – the pins' alternate functions (TXD1/RXD1, SDA/SCL, MOSI/MISO/SCK, OC outputs, ADC channels)
